name: Demographic Threat
description: The claim that Muslim populations are growing at a rate that will displace existing populations through birth rates, migration, or both.

name: Legal System Threat
description: The claim that Muslims intend to replace national law with Sharia law, or that Sharia law already operates as a parallel legal system in Muslim communities.

name: Violent Extremism Attribution
description: The claim that violence committed by any Muslim individual or group is representative of Muslims collectively, or that Islam as a religion is uniquely linked to violence.

name: Loyalty and Allegiance
description: The claim that Muslims' primary loyalty is to a global Islamic community (ummah) rather than their country of residence, making them inherently untrustworthy citizens.

name: Cultural Incompatibility
description: The claim that Islamic culture is fundamentally incompatible with Western liberal values — specifically regarding gender equality, LGBTQ+ rights, and freedom of speech.

name: Manufactured Statistics
description: The distribution of fabricated or heavily manipulated statistics attributed to legitimate sources to create the impression of documented evidence for other narrative clusters.

name: Victimhood Inversion
description: The claim that Muslims are not victims of Islamophobia but are actually perpetrating victimhood claims to gain political power, silence criticism, or advance a covert agenda.
